terminal_evidence_policy: Every failed attempt remains immutable. A correction requires a new namespace, bounded contract, offline preflight, and explicit one-shot authorization before any heavy process.

failures.finding: Overall length failed by 0.215 m and direct review rejected the generic tube fuselage, slab wings, primitive cowling/propeller, disconnected canopy, missing tail/gear/cockpit detail and obstructed close views.
failures.disposition: R5 is not production art and must not be imported as accepted art. Continue through R6 only.

failures.finding: Offline design is hash-frozen but classification remains AWAITING_REFERENCE_INPUT; Blender production is not authorized.
failures.disposition: Complete verified reference intake, then freeze and explicitly authorize one Blender production attempt.

failures.finding: Pathfinder, lighthouse and radar frames exceeded the 2% clipping contract and showed overexposed, disconnected slab/primitive proxy geometry.
failures.disposition: Recovery12 is terminal. Replace proxy hero assets through a new production-art lane; do not retry Recovery12/13.

failures.finding: The single Unreal launch timed out after 543.34 seconds. The governed runtime namespace and lifecycle heartbeat never appeared; no captures or restoration proof were produced.
failures.disposition: Recovery04 is terminal. Recovery05 separately corrects module identity, messaging isolation and environment mobility.

failures.finding: The source was correct, but final validation used an unsupported PowerShell byte-array SequenceEqual call.
failures.disposition: Preserve failure. Separate Validation Recovery01 passed using hashes, byte counts and StructuralEqualityComparer.

failures.finding: The corrected environment source has not been compiled. The current editor DLL predates the correction.
failures.disposition: Next executable gate; requires explicit one-shot authorization.

failures.finding: Unique Recovery05 source exists but has no accepted native build or runtime proof.
failures.disposition: Build only after Gate 2 passes and a separate one-shot prompt is frozen and authorized.

failures.finding: Three accepted 1080p combat captures, contextual shader/PSO review, and a 20-minute input-driven combat soak remain missing.
failures.disposition: Measure ADS plus fire, rifle impact, Igla launch/impact, drone breakup and boss destruction in the current packaged candidate.

failures.finding: Drone breakup and ADS/fire caused multi-second or five-second freezes in earlier builds.
failures.disposition: Require pooled/prewarmed destruction, bounded debris, asynchronous preparation, audio preload and strict packaged hitch evidence before acceptance.

failures.finding: Only 6 of 24 Poly Haven families are manifest-verified, 15 nonempty families rely on a root CC0 claim without file manifests, and 3 families are empty/unverified placeholders. Fab/Bridge acquisitions lack a complete campaign receipt set.
failures.disposition: Bind every used third-party asset to product/source, creator, license, version, acquisition receipt and file hashes before promotion.

failures.finding: Water, WaterAdvanced, Landmass and Volumetrics are currently disabled despite earlier plans that assumed their availability.
failures.disposition: Do not enable speculatively. Resolve required technology per vertical-slice design in a bounded offline configuration gate.

failures.evidence: Repeated user-reported whole-PC freezes during prior Unreal/install/build sessions
failures.finding: Concurrent or unsupervised heavy processes have repeatedly frozen the workstation.
failures.disposition: One heavy process at a time; process preflight; bounded timeout; direct stdout/stderr; live supervision; no automatic retry.
